Theme

Computing & programming

format noun and verb

of a file, a disk or a book

also file format, formats, formatting, reformat, format a disk

modern

Traupman 261, 318
Traupman 318

fōrma, fōrmae f.

noun, first declension

a format

Classically shape, figure, beauty, and a mould or a shoemaker’s last; Traupman stretches it to a computer format. A book’s format, too: liber in fōrmā octāvā ēditus, an octavo (M-O s.v. format: octavo).

Other words

  • cōnfōrmō, cōnfōrmāre, cōnfōrmāvī, cōnfōrmātum — format (a disk)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · modern · Traupman 261: (discum) cōnfōrmāre

    Classically to shape, fashion, train (Cicero).

Examples

  • discum cōnfōrmāre

    to format a diskTraupman 318

See also computer, document.
